column1: that section which shall have effect as section 18I

by the insertion immediately after secti: 18I. The  employer  of  a  female
employee in any shop or office shall,
if  she  is  nursing  a  child  under  one
year of age, allow her, in any period
of nine hours, two nursing intervals
at  such  times  as  she  may  require.
Each interval shall, where a creche
or  other  suitable  place  is  provided
by  such  employer  to  such  female
employee for nursing such child, be
not  less  than  thirty  minutes,  and
where  no  creche  or  other  suitable
place is so provided, be not less than
one hour, and shall be in addition to
any interval provided to such female
employee for meals or rest under any
written law and be regarded, for the
purposes of her employment, as time
during which she has worked in her
employment.”.
